summary: Nightly report job skipped for one night after a cron edit

sections.heading: Timeline
sections.body:
02:00 nightly job did not start
08:15 missing report noticed by finance
08:40 cron entry found commented out; restored and run manually

sections.heading: Impact
sections.body: One nightly report delivered six hours late; no data lost.

sections.heading: Contributing Factors
sections.body: The engineer failed to uncomment the cron line after testing and should have double-checked. It was human error.

sections.heading: What Went Well
sections.body: Finance had a contact and the manual run path was documented.

sections.heading: Action Items
sections.body: Alert when the nightly job has not started by 02:15 — owner: data-team, due: 2026-09-20
